scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.dev:local: npm run infra:up && npm run seed:actors:local && (npm run dev:backend:local & npm run dev:frontend)
scripts.dev:backend:local: env DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_USERNAME=cloneos DB_PASSWORD=cloneos DB_NAME=cloneos DB_SSL=false REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6379 NODE_ENV=development npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.seed:actors:local: env DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_USERNAME=cloneos DB_PASSWORD=cloneos DB_NAME=cloneos DB_SSL=false REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6379 NODE_ENV=development npm --prefix backend run seed:actors
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
